about_the_game:
UPDATE 12/10/2025

About This Game 

Buy the comic to witness the betrayal that created the first Velmorr.

One Man’s Eternal Night is a savage 3D action-adventure where you become Omen, a fallen prince betrayed by love, cursed by Hell, and reborn as the first and only Velmorr a monstrous, living weapon.

🩸 In dev terms? We don’t want you to win.

If you survive Omen, we’ll reward you like the legend you are because only legends make it out alive.

Please check the hardware requirements. We're not sure you even have the specs to run this master of a game.

Key Features

Your Body Is the Arsenal
Rip through enemies with bare fists, or shift your limbs into bladed axes, greatswords, or bone-hammers. You don’t equip weapons. You become them.

Unleash the Velmorr Form
Tap into the monster sealed inside. Towering, winged, and godless — this is your final form. Built from agony. Fueled by betrayal. Created by Moloch.

The Island Hates You
Welcome to Santanazes — a prison disguised as a world. The longer you survive, the more it evolves to kill you. Enemies adapt. The AI remembers.

Feed or Fade
Drinking blood doesn't make you strong — it keeps your body from rotting. Heal through carnage. Regain your human shape, but never your soul.

Constant Threat
Demon hounds stalk the island. They work in packs. They don’t stop. And they only howl when they're close.

Built for Legends
No hand-holding. No fetch quests. Just violence, grief, and survival. This isn’t a hero’s journey. It’s a curse simulator.

Contact: omenthegamesa@gmail.com

All footage subject to change

content_descriptors.notes: Torture. Gore. Betrayal. This is a world of demons, death, and twisted love. You’re not here to save the world. You’re here to make it bleed for what it did to you.
